# LuminaSky Glass Services

> Glass and window repair specialists serving the Greater Toronto Area. We repair sealed units, foggy glass, window hardware, front door glass, patio doors, skylights, and commercial glass. Family-owned since 2024.

## Company Info
- Name: LuminaSky Glass Services
- Location: Thornhill, Ontario, Canada
- Phone: 437-344-8490
- Email: service@luminasky.com
- Website: https://www.luminasky.com
- Hours: Open 24/7
- Service type: Mobile service (we come to you)
- Google Reviews: 60+ five-star reviews

## Core Services

### Residential Glass
- [Glass Replacement](https://www.luminasky.com/glass-replacement): Broken or cracked sealed unit replacement, $300-$1,400 per unit depending on size
- [Foggy Glass Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/foggy-windows): Sealed unit replacement for condensation between panes, $300-$1,400 per unit
- [Window Replacement](https://www.luminasky.com/window-replacement): Full window replacement including frame, $800-$3,000 per window
- [Front Door Glass](https://www.luminasky.com/front-door-glass): Decorative, frosted, or clear glass inserts, $450-$1,200

### Window Hardware
- [Window Crank Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/cranks): Casement and awning window hardware repair, same-day service
- [Window Screens](https://www.luminasky.com/window-screens): Custom screen building and re-screening, $75-$250 per screen

### Doors
- [Patio Door Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/patio-door-repair): Rollers, tracks, locks, and glass replacement, $650-$2,500
- [Screen and Storm Doors](https://www.luminasky.com/screen-storm-doors): Installation and repair, $150-$650

### Specialty
- [Skylight Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/skylights): Leak repair and glass replacement, $650-$3,500
- [Commercial Glass](https://www.luminasky.com/commercial-glass-repair): Storefronts, office partitions, safety glass, $500-$10,000
- [Emergency Glass Repair](https://www.luminasky.com/emergency-glass-repair): 24/7 board-up and same-day glass replacement, $300-$1,500

### For Property Managers
- [Property Manager Services](https://www.luminasky.com/property-managers): Building glass audits, priority scheduling, consolidated billing

## How It Works
1. Call or text 437-344-8490 for a $30 site visit (credited toward repair)
2. Technician measures and provides a written quote on the spot
3. Glass is custom-made, then installed on a scheduled return visit
4. Hardware repairs are typically completed same-day on the first visit

## Pricing Notes
- All prices are approximate ranges and vary by size, accessibility, and project scope
- $30 site visit fee is credited toward the repair if you proceed
- Written fixed-price quote provided on site before any work begins
- No hidden fees

## Warranty
- 5-year seal warranty on glass
- 2-year workmanship warranty on glass installation
- 1-year warranty on hardware repairs

## About
Founded by Dan in 2024. LuminaSky focuses on repairing existing windows rather than replacing them, saving homeowners money. 60+ five-star Google reviews.
